resume_text:
Maya Patel
Target: Machine Learning / Data Science Engineer
Location: Cambridge, United Kingdom; open to hybrid work.
Education: MSc Data Science, University of Bristol; BSc Computer Science.
Experience: 4 years building Python machine-learning products. At Northstar Retail Analytics she deployed demand-forecasting models through FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS. She implemented batch and real-time feature pipelines with SQL, Airflow and PostgreSQL, and partnered with React engineers on model-monitoring dashboards.
Project evidence: Reduced inference P95 latency by 31% after profiling model and API bottlenecks. Built an MLflow experiment registry and production drift alerts.
Skills: Python, SQL, FastAPI, Flask, React, machine learning, statistics, data visualization, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow, PostgreSQL, MLflow.
Constraints: Does not claim credit-risk underwriting, broadcast engineering, biomedical laboratory work or a PhD.

Li Jiawen
Target: LLM Application Engineer
Location: Shanghai, China; available for remote collaboration but does not hold UK work authorization.
Education: Master of Electronic Information, Shanghai University; Bachelor of Intelligent Science and Technology.
Experience: 2 years of project and internship experience with Python services and retrieval-augmented generation. Built a FastAPI service using LangChain, Chroma, BM25/RRF retrieval and a BGE reranker. Designed Pydantic tool schemas, evidence citations and request-level audit logs.
Project evidence: Created a Chinese evaluation set for resume and job-description retrieval; implemented Docker packaging and pytest regression tests.
Skills: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, RAG, Chroma, Docker, NLP, PyTorch, SQL.
Constraints: No production full-stack JavaScript experience, no financial underwriting experience and no biomedical PhD.

Oliver Grant
Target: Credit Risk and Portfolio Analytics
Location: London, United Kingdom; available for hybrid office work.
Education: MSc Finance, London School of Economics; BSc Economics.
Experience: 6 years in credit underwriting and counterparty-risk analysis at a UK commercial bank. Managed a portfolio of 180 corporate and non-bank financial institution clients, completed annual reviews, monitored watch lists and designed stress-testing scenarios. Partnered with legal and collateral teams during covenant breaches and restructuring cases.
Project evidence: Automated portfolio reporting with SQL and Python and introduced early-warning indicators for rating deterioration.
Skills: credit risk, risk management, SQL, Python, statistics, stakeholder communication.
Constraints: No machine-learning production deployment, broadcast engineering or laboratory research experience.

Sofia Martinez
Target: Postdoctoral Research in Tissue Regeneration
Location: Manchester, United Kingdom; has independent UK work authorization.
Education: PhD Cell Biology, University of Manchester; thesis on macrophage signalling during skin repair.
Experience: 5 years of doctoral and postdoctoral laboratory research. Designed murine wound-healing experiments, maintained complete laboratory records and co-authored three peer-reviewed manuscripts.
Project evidence: Performed immunohistochemistry, PCR, confocal microscopy and primary mouse-cell culture. Analysed single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics data with Python and R; collaborated on a proteomics study.
Skills: microscopy, transcriptomics, proteomics, Python, statistics, scientific writing, murine models.
Constraints: No commercial credit-risk, broadcast or production web-platform experience.

Noah Williams
Target: Broadcast Engineer
Location: London, United Kingdom; accepts rotating shifts, weekends and occasional nights.
Education: BEng Broadcast and Media Systems.
Experience: 8 years supporting live football and rugby productions. Provided tier-1 and tier-2 incident response for studios, galleries and post-production systems; maintained technical documentation and coordinated escalation during live events.
Project evidence: Migrated an HD facility to SMPTE ST 2110 IP video with AES67 audio and NMOS discovery. Troubleshot UHD/HDR signal paths, Dolby Atmos monitoring, replay systems, virtualization, storage and network faults.
Skills: broadcast engineering, Linux, networking, cloud services, incident management, documentation, project coordination.
Constraints: No data-science model development, credit underwriting or life-science research.

Amina Yusuf
Target: Data Engineer
Location: Bristol, United Kingdom; prefers remote-first or hybrid roles.
Education: BSc Software Engineering.
Experience: 4 years developing healthcare and telemetry data pipelines. Built Python and SQL ingestion services, Spark transformations and Airflow DAGs on AWS; operated Kafka topics, PostgreSQL warehouses and Docker workloads.
Project evidence: Implemented data-quality checks for wearable-sensor streams and reduced failed daily pipelines by 38%. Worked with data scientists to expose curated features but did not train research models.
Skills: Python, SQL, Spark, Airflow, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, data quality.
Constraints: No PhD, no murine laboratory experience, no financial underwriting and no broadcast engineering.
